verdict.rationale: A probe reports an official Groq MCP server documented at console.groq.com/docs/mcp, so the product itself appears to ship this capability. The pack contains no content from that page. The remote-MCP docs describe Groq acting as an MCP client that consumes third-party servers, which is a different role and earns no credit here. Missing for 10: documented tools and scope of the official MCP server, setup and auth instructions for connecting an agent, transport details, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: official MCP server documented at https://console.groq.com/docs/mcp
